local function createGroupedPanel(parent, title)
    local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
    panel.Name = (title:gsub("%s+", "")) .. "Panel"
    panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 0)
    panel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    panel.BackgroundColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.panel
    panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
    panel.ZIndex = 11
    panel.Parent = parent
    corner(panel, 17)
    outline(panel, HOTHX_THEME.edge, 0.48, 1)

    local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 15)
    padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 15)
    padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 13)
    padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15)
    padding.Parent = panel

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Parent = panel

    local header = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    header.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
    header.Text = "[+]  " .. string.upper(tostring(title))
    header.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.lime
    header.TextSize = 12
    header.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    header.ZIndex = 12
    header.Parent = panel

    return panel
end

local function groupedToggle(parent, title, default, callback, description)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, description and description ~= "" and 42 or 32)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    row.ZIndex = 12
    row.Parent = parent

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 20)
    label.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
    label.Text = tostring(title)
    label.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.text
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.ZIndex = 13
    label.Parent = row

    if description and description ~= "" then
        local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18)
        sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 16)
        sub.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
        sub.Text = tostring(description)
        sub.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.sub
        sub.TextSize = 10
        sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        sub.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        sub.ZIndex = 13
        sub.Parent = row
    end

    local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.AutoButtonColor = false
    hit.ZIndex = 14
    hit.Parent = row

    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
    track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 22)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.item
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.ZIndex = 13
    track.Parent = row
    corner(track, 11)
    local trackStroke = outline(track, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.76, 1)

    local gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
    gloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
    gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
    gloss.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
    gloss.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0.48, 0)
    gloss.ZIndex = 13
    gloss.Parent = track
    corner(gloss, 10)

    local knobShadow = Instance.new("Frame")
    knobShadow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knobShadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
    knobShadow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    knobShadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
    knobShadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knobShadow.ZIndex = 13
    knobShadow.Parent = track
    corner(knobShadow, 10)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 249, 252)
    knob.ZIndex = 14
    knob.Parent = track
    corner(knob, 9)
    outline(knob, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.88, 1)

    local state = default == true
    local function paint(noTween)
        local targetColor = state and HOTHX_THEME.lime or HOTHX_THEME.item
        local strokeColor = state and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        local strokeTransparency = state and 0.56 or 0.8
        local knobColor = state and Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20) or HOTHX_THEME.lime
        local pos = state and UDim2.new(1, -11, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 11, 0.5, 0)
        if noTween then
            track.BackgroundColor3 = targetColor
            trackStroke.Color = strokeColor
            trackStroke.Transparency = strokeTransparency
            knob.BackgroundColor3 = knobColor
            knob.Position = pos
            knobShadow.Position = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset + 1)
        else
            TweenService:Create(track, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundColor3=targetColor}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(trackStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Color=strokeColor, Transparency=strokeTransparency}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Position=pos, BackgroundColor3=knobColor}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(knobShadow, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Position=UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset + 1)}):Play()
        end
    end
    paint(true)

    local function set(value, fire)
        state = value == true
        paint(false)
        if fire ~= false and type(callback) == "function" then
            pcall(callback, state)
        end
    end

    hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        set(not state, true)
    end)

    return {Get=function() return state end, Set=set, Instance=row}
end

local function groupedDropdown(parent, title, options, default, callback, description)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, description and description ~= "" and 72 or 56)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    row.ZIndex = 12
    row.Parent = parent

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
    label.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
    label.Text = tostring(title)
    label.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.text
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.ZIndex = 13
    label.Parent = row

    if description and description ~= "" then
        local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
        sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
        sub.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
        sub.Text = tostring(description)
        sub.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.sub
        sub.TextSize = 10
        sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        sub.ZIndex = 13
        sub.Parent = row
    end

    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -30)
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.item
    button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    button.Text = ""
    button.ZIndex = 13
    button.Parent = row
    corner(button, 12)
    outline(button, HOTHX_THEME.edge, 0.34, 1)

    local current = default or (options and options[1]) or "None"
    local valueLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valueLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valueLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0)
    valueLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
    valueLabel.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
    valueLabel.Text = tostring(current)
    valueLabel.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.text
    valueLabel.TextSize = 12
    valueLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    valueLabel.ZIndex = 14
    valueLabel.Parent = button

    local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
    arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
    arrow.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
    arrow.Text = "↕"
    arrow.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.lime
    arrow.TextSize = 13
    arrow.ZIndex = 14
    arrow.Parent = button

    local state = tostring(current)
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local index = table.find(options, state) or 1
        index += 1
        if index > #options then index = 1 end
        state = tostring(options[index])
        valueLabel.Text = state
        if type(callback) == "function" then pcall(callback, state) end
    end)

    return {Get=function() return state end, Set=function(v, fire)
        state = tostring(v)
        valueLabel.Text = state
        if fire ~= false and type(callback) == "function" then pcall(callback, state) end
    end, Instance=row}
end

local function groupedSlider(parent, title, minValue, maxValue, defaultValue, increment, callback, description)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, description and description ~= "" and 72 or 58)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    row.ZIndex = 12
    row.Parent = parent

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 18)
    label.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
    label.Text = tostring(title)
    label.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.text
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.ZIndex = 13
    label.Parent = row

    local valueLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valueLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valueLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    valueLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    valueLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 18)
    valueLabel.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
    valueLabel.Text = tostring(defaultValue)
    valueLabel.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.text
    valueLabel.TextSize = 12
    valueLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valueLabel.ZIndex = 13
    valueLabel.Parent = row

    if description and description ~= "" then
        local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
        sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
        sub.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
        sub.Text = tostring(description)
        sub.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.sub
        sub.TextSize = 10
        sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        sub.ZIndex = 13
        sub.Parent = row
    end

    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12)
    track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 33, 28)
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.ZIndex = 13
    track.Parent = row
    corner(track, 4)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.lime
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = 14
    fill.Parent = track
    corner(fill, 4)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.lime
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 15
    knob.Parent = track
    corner(knob, 8)
    outline(knob, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.88, 1)

    local value = defaultValue
    local draggingSlider = false

    local function quantize(raw)
        local q = math.floor(((raw - minValue) / increment) + 0.5) * increment + minValue
        return math.clamp(q, minValue, maxValue)
    end

    local function paint()
        local alpha = (value - minValue) / math.max(maxValue - minValue, 1e-6)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
        if math.abs(value - math.floor(value)) < 1e-6 then
            valueLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(value))
        else
            valueLabel.Text = string.format("%.1f", value)
        end
    end

    local function set(v, fire)
        value = quantize(tonumber(v) or value)
        paint()
        if fire ~= false and type(callback) == "function" then pcall(callback, value) end
    end

    local function updateFromX(x)
        local alpha = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
        set(minValue + (maxValue - minValue) * alpha, true)
    end

    local sliderHit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    sliderHit.Name = "TouchSliderHitArea"
    sliderHit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sliderHit.Text = ""
    sliderHit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -30)
    sliderHit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    sliderHit.ZIndex = 16
    sliderHit.Parent = row
    sliderHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = true
            updateFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    sliderHit.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    paint()
    return {Get=function() return value end, Set=set, Instance=row}
end

local function HOTHX_setControlGroupVisible(group, visible)
    for _, handle in ipairs(group) do
        if handle and handle.Instance then
            handle.Instance.Visible = visible == true
        end
    end
end

-- In phone portrait mode, turn the sidebar into a tab ribbon and both
-- content columns into ONE full-width scrolling column. No buttons are dropped.
local HOTHX_PORTRAIT_ACTIVE = nil
local HOTHX_RIGHT_PANELS = {}
local HOTHX_PORTRAIT_CAMERA_CONN = nil
local function HOTHX_updatePortraitLayout()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local v = cam.ViewportSize
    local portrait = HOTHX_UI_IS_MOBILE and v.X < v.Y and v.X <= 640
    if portrait ~= HOTHX_PORTRAIT_ACTIVE then
        HOTHX_PORTRAIT_ACTIVE = portrait
        if portrait then
            Container.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 720)
            SideBar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 91)
            SideBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(484, 62)
            SidePadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 7)
            SidePadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
            SideLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
            SideLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)
            Divider.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 165)
            Divider.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(480, 1)
            SectionHeading.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 175)
            PageHint.Position = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0, 179)
            PagesRoot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 211)
            PagesRoot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(484, 447)
            SideFooter.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 679)
            StatusText.Visible = false
            SearchIcon.Visible = false
            MiniStats.Visible = false
            for _, tab in ipairs({CombatTab, VisualTab, MiscTab}) do
                tab.button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 48)
                tab.left.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                tab.left.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(484, 447)
                tab.right.Visible = false
                local panels = {}
                for _, child in ipairs(tab.right:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Frame") then
                        table.insert(panels, child)
                    end
                end
                HOTHX_RIGHT_PANELS[tab] = panels
                for i, panel in ipairs(panels) do
                    panel.LayoutOrder = 100 + i
                    panel.Parent = tab.left
                end
            end
        else
            Container.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(780, 540)
            SideBar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 90)
            SideBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(169, 418)
            SidePadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 18)
            SidePadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
            SideLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
            SideLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
            Divider.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(197, 90)
            Divider.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 418)
            SectionHeading.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(212, 84)
            PageHint.Position = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0, 90)
            PagesRoot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(209, 119)
            PagesRoot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(552, 392)
            SideFooter.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 456)
            StatusText.Visible = true
            SearchIcon.Visible = true
            MiniStats.Visible = true
            for _, tab in ipairs({CombatTab, VisualTab, MiscTab}) do
                tab.button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 51)
                tab.left.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                tab.left.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(269, 392)
                tab.right.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(282, 0)
                tab.right.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(269, 392)
                for _, panel in ipairs(HOTHX_RIGHT_PANELS[tab] or {}) do
                    panel.Parent = tab.right
                    panel.LayoutOrder = 0
                end
                HOTHX_RIGHT_PANELS[tab] = nil
                tab.right.Visible = true
            end
        end
    end
    HOTHX_updateResponsiveScale()
end
local function HOTHX_bindPortraitCamera()
    if HOTHX_PORTRAIT_CAMERA_CONN then HOTHX_PORTRAIT_CAMERA_CONN:Disconnect() end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then
        HOTHX_PORTRAIT_CAMERA_CONN = cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(HOTHX_updatePortraitLayout)
    end
    HOTHX_updatePortraitLayout()
end
HOTHX_bindPortraitCamera()
workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
    task.defer(HOTHX_bindPortraitCamera)
end)

-- Drag panel by the header.
local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPosition = nil

Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = Container.Position
    end
end)

Header.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging or not dragStart or not startPosition then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        Container.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- Float a circular pixel launcher when the main panel is hidden.
local OpenBubble = Instance.new("TextButton")
OpenBubble.Name = "HOTHX_ReopenBubble"
OpenBubble.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
OpenBubble.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.50, 0)
OpenBubble.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 58)
OpenBubble.BackgroundColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.lime
OpenBubble.BorderSizePixel = 0
OpenBubble.Font = HOTHX_PIXEL_FONT
OpenBubble.Text = "H"
OpenBubble.TextSize = 30
OpenBubble.TextColor3 = HOTHX_THEME.bg
OpenBubble.Visible = false
OpenBubble.ZIndex = 50
OpenBubble.Parent = Gui
corner(OpenBubble, 30)
outline(OpenBubble, HOTHX_THEME.text, 0.33, 2)

 -- HALLOWEEN effects are isolated from the main menu scope to avoid
 -- excess Luau local registers in this large script.
;(function()
-- HALLOWEEN ORB TRANSITION: no asset downloads, permanent RenderStepped loops,
-- or changes to the combat/visual/misc backend. Runs only on a UI toggle.
local HOTHX_ORB_LAYER = Instance.new("Frame")
HOTHX_ORB_LAYER.Name = "HalloweenFlyingOrbs"
HOTHX_ORB_LAYER.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
HOTHX_ORB_LAYER.BackgroundTransparency = 1
HOTHX_ORB_LAYER.BorderSizePixel = 0
HOTHX_ORB_LAYER.Active = false
HOTHX_ORB_LAYER.ZIndex = 60
HOTHX_ORB_LAYER.Parent = Gui

local HOTHX_BUBBLE_SCALE = Instance.new("UIScale")
HOTHX_BUBBLE_SCALE.Name = "HalloweenBubbleBounce"
HOTHX_BUBBLE_SCALE.Scale = 1
HOTHX_BUBBLE_SCALE.Parent = OpenBubble

outline(OpenBubble, Color3.fromRGB(255, 211, 123), 0.12, 2.5).Name = "PumpkinGlowRing"

local HOTHX_panelOpen = true
local HOTHX_isAnimating = false
local HOTHX_savedPanelPosition = Container.Position

local function HOTHX_bubbleCenter()
    return OpenBubble.AbsolutePosition + OpenBubble.AbsoluteSize * 0.5
end

local function HOTHX_panelCenterFromPosition(position)
    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
    return Vector2.new(
        viewport.X * position.X.Scale + position.X.Offset,
        viewport.Y * position.Y.Scale + position.Y.Offset
    )
end

local function HOTHX_tween(object, duration, style, direction, goal)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(object, TweenInfo.new(duration, style, direction), goal)
    tween:Play()
    return tween
end

-- Glowing round dots arc between the menu and the circular reopen button.
local function HOTHX_flyOrbs(closing, menuCenter, bubbleCenter, extent)
    local count = HOTHX_UI_IS_MOBILE and 13 or 19
    for i = 1, count do
        local theta = (i / count) * math.pi * 2
        local orbit = Vector2.new(math.cos(theta) * extent.X, math.sin(theta) * extent.Y)
        local start = closing and (menuCenter + orbit) or (bubbleCenter + orbit.Unit * 4)
        local target = closing and (bubbleCenter + orbit.Unit * 4) or (menuCenter + orbit)
        local bend = Vector2.new(-math.sin(theta), math.cos(theta)) * (18 + (i % 5) * 6)
        local middle = start:Lerp(target, 0.52) + bend
        local size = 5 + (i % 4) * 2
        local stagger = (i - 1) * 0.013
        task.delay(stagger, function()
            if not HOTHX_ORB_LAYER.Parent then return end
            local orb = Instance.new("Frame")
            orb.Name = "FlyingPumpkinSpark"
            orb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            orb.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(start.X, start.Y)
            orb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
            orb.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 4 == 0)
                and Color3.fromRGB(171, 104, 246)
                or ((i % 3 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 208, 92) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 119, 23))
            orb.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
            orb.BorderSizePixel = 0
            orb.ZIndex = 70
            orb.Active = false
            orb.Parent = HOTHX_ORB_LAYER
            corner(orb, 50)

            local glow = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            glow.Color = orb.BackgroundColor3
            glow.Thickness = 2
            glow.Transparency = 0.45
            glow.Parent = orb

            local leg1 = HOTHX_tween(orb, 0.19, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(middle.X, middle.Y),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size + 3, size + 3),
            })
            leg1.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
                if playbackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Completed or not orb.Parent then
                    orb:Destroy()
                    return
                end
                local leg2 = HOTHX_tween(orb, 0.23, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, {
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(target.X, target.Y),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                })
                leg2.Completed:Connect(function() orb:Destroy() end)
            end)
        end)
    end
end

local function HOTHX_setPanelOpen(shouldOpen)
    shouldOpen = (shouldOpen == true)
    if HOTHX_isAnimating or shouldOpen == HOTHX_panelOpen then return end
    HOTHX_isAnimating = true
    HOTHX_panelOpen = shouldOpen

    local bubbleCenter = HOTHX_bubbleCenter()
    local bubblePosition = UDim2.fromOffset(bubbleCenter.X, bubbleCenter.Y)

    if not shouldOpen then
        -- Hide: the whole menu is pulled into the floating circle.
        HOTHX_savedPanelPosition = Container.Position
        local menuCenter = Container.AbsolutePosition + Container.AbsoluteSize * 0.5
        local extent = Vector2.new(
            math.max(Container.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.43, 40),
            math.max(Container.AbsoluteSize.Y * 0.39, 36)
        )
        HOTHX_flyOrbs(true, menuCenter, bubbleCenter, extent)
        OpenBubble.Visible = true
        HOTHX_BUBBLE_SCALE.Scale = 0.08
        HOTHX_tween(OpenBubble, 0.30, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, {
            BackgroundTransparency = 0,
        })
        HOTHX_tween(Container, 0.44, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In, {
            Position = bubblePosition,
        })
        HOTHX_tween(HOTHX_UI_SCALE, 0.44, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In, {
            Scale = 0.045,
        })
        task.delay(0.23, function()
            HOTHX_tween(HOTHX_BUBBLE_SCALE, 0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, {
                Scale = 1,
            })
        end)
        task.delay(0.48, function()
            Container.Visible = false
            Container.Position = HOTHX_savedPanelPosition
            HOTHX_updateResponsiveScale()
            HOTHX_BUBBLE_SCALE.Scale = 1
            HOTHX_isAnimating = false
        end)
    else
        -- Reveal: orbs fly out while the menu expands from the circle.
        Container.Position = HOTHX_savedPanelPosition
        HOTHX_updateResponsiveScale()
        local fullScale = HOTHX_UI_SCALE.Scale
        local menuCenter = HOTHX_panelCenterFromPosition(HOTHX_savedPanelPosition)
        local extent = Vector2.new(Container.Size.X.Offset * fullScale * 0.43,
            Container.Size.Y.Offset * fullScale * 0.39)
        HOTHX_flyOrbs(false, menuCenter, bubbleCenter, extent)
        Container.Position = bubblePosition
        HOTHX_UI_SCALE.Scale = 0.045
        Container.Visible = true
        HOTHX_tween(Container, 0.49, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, {
            Position = HOTHX_savedPanelPosition,
        })
        HOTHX_tween(HOTHX_UI_SCALE, 0.49, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, {
            Scale = fullScale,
        })
        HOTHX_tween(HOTHX_BUBBLE_SCALE, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, {
            Scale = 0.10,
        })
        task.delay(0.22, function()
            OpenBubble.Visible = false
            HOTHX_BUBBLE_SCALE.Scale = 1
        end)
        task.delay(0.51, function()
            Container.Position = HOTHX_savedPanelPosition
            HOTHX_updateResponsiveScale()
            HOTHX_isAnimating = false
        end)
    end
end

local function togglePanel()
    HOTHX_setPanelOpen(not HOTHX_panelOpen)
end
Minimize.MouseButton1Click:Connect(togglePanel)
OpenBubble.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not OpenBubble:GetAttribute("WasDragged") then
        HOTHX_setPanelOpen(true)
    end
    OpenBubble:SetAttribute("WasDragged", false)
end)

-- Move the floating launcher without accidentally reopening it.
local bubbleStart = nil
local bubblePosition = nil
local bubbleActive = false
OpenBubble.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        bubbleActive = true
        bubbleStart = input.Position
        bubblePosition = OpenBubble.Position
        OpenBubble:SetAttribute("WasDragged", false)
    end
end)
OpenBubble.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        bubbleActive = false
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not bubbleActive or not bubbleStart then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = input.Position - bubbleStart
        if delta.Magnitude > 9 then
            OpenBubble:SetAttribute("WasDragged", true)
            OpenBubble.Position = UDim2.new(bubblePosition.X.Scale, bubblePosition.X.Offset + delta.X, bubblePosition.Y.Scale, bubblePosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
        togglePanel()
    end
end)

end)()

-- Apply an optional published Minecraft font family asset only to this GUI.
if HOTHX_PIXEL_FACE then
    local function stylePixel(item)
        if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") or item:IsA("TextBox") then
            pcall(function() item.FontFace = HOTHX_PIXEL_FACE end)
        end
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(Gui:GetDescendants()) do stylePixel(item) end
    Gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item)
        task.defer(function() if item.Parent then stylePixel(item) end end)
    end)
end

Notify("HOTHXv8 PRO MAX", HOTHX_BG_IMAGE_ASSET and "Halloween UI + Background Loaded" or "Halloween UI Loaded", 2)
-- Allow the menu to paint before running expensive startup jobs.
-- These jobs never block the initial UI thread.
task.delay(0.15, _HOTHX_startRemoteCapture)
-- No wallpaper is loaded: the native pixel UI paints instantly.
end)() -- end separated menu construction scope
end)() -- end original script scope
